definition: a track or mark left by something passing
description: Early morning on a wide sandy beach. A newly hatched sea turtle drags itself down the wet sand towards the water, and behind it a long double line of flipper prints runs back up the beach, with more hatchlings strung out along the same track. A woman in a khaki shirt and a red headband kneels behind them with both hands pressed to her mouth, delighted. In the last shots the white foam of a wave washes up over the sand and reaches the turtles.
